Large-by-default sizing: each player uses height: clamp(360px, 62vh, 820px) on tablets/phones.

One-column layout on iPad for max width.

In-page “Fill Screen” (CSS stretch) stays, but you probably won’t need it now.

Keeps your EN/ES alternation and your same video IDs.

Canvas → Page → HTML view → paste all → Save.
